name: C++
description: C++ is a systems programming language that gives you complete control over memory and hardware. It powers game engines, browsers (Chrome), operating systems, embedded devices, and high-frequency trading. These are the definitive free resources — vetted, current, and complete.

items.title: LearnCpp.com
items.description: Universally recommended as the gold standard for learning modern C++ from scratch with step-by-step tutorials and quizzes.

items.title: C++ Core Guidelines
items.description: Authored by Bjarne Stroustrup and Herb Sutter. The ultimate best-practices guide for modern C++.

items.title: cppreference.com
items.description: The definitive exhaustive technical reference for the C++ language and Standard Library, updated for C++20/23/26.

items.title: isocpp.org
items.description: The central hub for standard C++ with FAQ, committee updates, and ISO standard announcements.

items.title: C++ Standard Proposals
items.description: Track the evolution of C++ through ISO committee papers and feature proposals.

items.title: freeCodeCamp — 31-Hour C++ Course
items.description: A massive comprehensive deep-dive course covering everything from beginner through memory management, OOP, and C++20 features.

items.title: C++ Programming Course (freeCodeCamp)
items.description: The 31-hour course on YouTube alongside focused crash courses on STL and templates.

items.title: C++ Weekly (Jason Turner)
items.description: Short bite-sized episodes focusing on modern C++ best practices and new features.

items.title: Exercism — C++ Track
items.description: 100 structured coding exercises across 19 concepts designed to teach idiomatic C++ with free human mentoring.

items.title: HackerRank — C++ Domain
items.description: Drill specific subdomains like classes, inheritance, strings, and the STL.

items.title: Codewars — C++ Kata
items.description: Solve community-created challenges across hundreds of difficulty levels.

items.title: C++ Core Guidelines
items.description: The ultimate cheatsheet for modern C++ best practices covering interfaces, resources, and concurrency.

items.title: C++ Cheatsheet (devhints)
items.description: A concise reference covering C++ syntax, data types, STL containers, and algorithms.

items.title: Standard C++ Blog (isocpp.org)
items.description: Official news tracking ISO committee trip reports, compiler releases, and standard proposals.

items.title: C++ Compiler Support
items.description: Track compiler support for C++20/23/26 features across GCC, Clang, MSVC, and others.

items.title: Reddit r/cpp
items.description: The main global forum for C++ news, library announcements, and technical discussions.

items.title: Reddit r/cpp_questions
items.description: Dedicated to learners asking questions and seeking debugging help.

items.title: Stack Overflow — C++ Tag
items.description: The definitive Q&A forum for C++ from template metaprogramming to optimization.
